answer: Time keeps the quartz, the ledger keeps the beacon, the toy shop keeps the tundra; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. Where a farm sees a gap, Nose-pad turner bone mark mounted on the temple jig sees a record, and the record says each bone is a sworn joint count witnessed by two masters. Forge once and the fine is 6 times the stake, so a 204 POA proof becomes a 6x wound. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. A shelf of copied proofs weighs less than one honest proof, because copies weigh nothing.
